More formally, we model the n candidates as having intrinsic values x1 , . . . , xn , where any employer would
derive utility xi from hiring candidate i. Throughout the paper, we assume without loss of generality that
x1 > x2 > · · · > xn . These values, however, are unknown to the employer; instead, they must use some
noisy procedure to rank the candidates. We model such a procedure as a randomized mechanism R that
takes in the true candidate values and draws a permutation π over those candidates from some distribution.
Our main results hold for families of distributions over permutations as defined below:

The choice of which ranking mechanism to use leads to a game-theoretic setting: both firms know the
accuracy parameters of the human evaluators (θH ) and the algorithm (θA ), and they must decide whether to
3

 use a human evaluator or the algorithm. This choice introduces a subtlety: for many ranking models, a firm’s
rational behavior depends not only on the accuracy of the ranking mechanism, but also on the underlying
candidate values x1 , . . . , xn . Thus, to fully specify a firm’s behavior, we assume that x1 , . . . , xn are drawn
from a known joint distribution D. Our main results will hold for any D, meaning they apply even when the
candidate values (but not their identities) are deterministically known.

In Random Utility Models, the underlying candidate values xi are perturbed by independent and identically
distributed noise εi ∼ E, and the perturbed values are ranked to produce π. Originally conceived in the
psychology literature [23], this model has been well-studied over nearly a century, [7, 4, 9, 24, 16, 22],
including more recently in the computer science and machine learning literature [2, 1, 19, 25, 13].
First, we must define a family of RUMs that satisfies the conditions of Definition 1. Assume without loss of
generality that the noise distribution E has unit variance. Then, consider the family of RUMs parameterized
by θ in which candidates are ranked according to xi + εθi . By this definition, the standard deviation of the
noise for a particular value of θ is simply 1/θ. Intuitively, larger values of θ reduce the effect of the noise,
making the ranking more accurate. In Theorem 5 in Appendix A, we show as long as the noise distribution
E has positive support on (−∞, ∞), this definition of Fθ meets the differentiability, asymptotic optimality,
and monotonicity conditions in Definition 1. For distributions with finite support, many of our results can
be generalized by relaxing strict inequalities in Definition 1 and Theorem 1 to weak inequalities.

An optimal choice of strategies for the k firms moving sequentially can be written as a sequence of length
k made up of the symbols A and H; the ith term in the sequence is equal to A if the ith firm to move
sequentially uses the algorithm as its optimal strategy (given the choices of the previous i − 1 firms), and it
is equal to H if the ith firm uses an independent human evaluation. We can therefore represent the choice
of optimal strategies, as the parameters (φH , φA ) vary, by a labeling of the (φH , φA )-plane: we label each
point (φH , φA ) with the length-k sequence that specifies the optimal sequence of strategies.
We can make the following initial formal observation about these optimal sequences:
Theorem 4. When φH ≥ φA , one optimal sequence is for all firms to choose H. When φH > φA , the
unique optimal sequence is for all firms to choose H.
We prove this formally in Appendix F.1, but we provide a sketch here. When φH ≥ φA , the first firm
to move in sequence will simply use the more accurate strategy, and hence will choose H. Now, proceeding
by induction, suppose that the first i firms have all chosen H, and consider the (i + 1)st firm to move in
sequence. Regardless of whether this firm chooses A or H, it will be making a selection that is independent
of the previous i selections, and hence it is optimal for it to choose H as well. Hence, by induction, it is an
optimal solution for all firms to choose H when φH ≥ φA . (This argument, slightly adapted, also directly
establishes that it is uniquely optimal for all firms to choose H when φH > φA .)

dimensions.required_check: Compare every expanded Lean binder domain, result quantifier, and proposition against the literal source statement. Check direction, scope, endpoint, and fixed-versus-uniform quantification; alpha-renaming is not a semantic change. For every formula used as a transformed density, likelihood, kernel, or probability law, check its sign, normalization, and Jacobian factor across the entire declared parameter domain. An algebraic scaling formula is not a probability-law conclusion outside the domain where those facts are proved.

dimensions.required_check: Compare the Lean carrier, finiteness/order/subtype restrictions, and every generic Type/Sort quantifier with the source domain. An arbitrary carrier or a silently strengthened finite carrier needs a source anchor or a checked bridge. When an expanded finite carrier encodes a source cardinal parameter through index arithmetic such as Fin (n + c), state the source parameter, the Lean expression, and a proved translation; local type names and inferred cardinality are not evidence. When a strict conclusion needs distinct, non-endpoint, or interior carrier elements, derive the exact cardinality threshold and witness from the source; a bare source phrase such as 'n candidates' does not supply N >= 3. When the generated surface requests a cardinality-boundary analysis, record the source and Lean cardinal domains, every smallest/endpoint case checked, and either the strictness witness or a semantic reason no such witness is needed. A theorem, wrapper, or carrier name is not that analysis. A local opaque/constant/axiom carrier must expose a checked refinement before it is treated as ordinary model data.

dimensions.required_check: For a finite/ordered probabilistic model, derive support at each endpoint from the source condition actually stated. Strict adjacent-tail comparisons do not by themselves supply a terminal cutoff or positive top/bottom atom; inspect zero mass, degenerate, and boundary cases separately.

transparent terminal definition closure with probability or integration construct
transparent terminal definition closure with standard Measure/Kernel carrier transport
dimensions.required_check: Identify the source stochastic process and the Lean joint law separately. Do not replace a source state recurrence, conditioning rule, or time-indexed law with an iid/product construction without a Lean-checked equality, simulation, or refinement from the source primitives. If either side sorts, ranks, relabels, or quotients samples before computing an outcome, prove the corresponding pushforward and outcome-equivariance bridge; matching marginal tables or an informal exchangeability argument is not enough. When the generated surface requests transformed-law analysis, record the source and Lean operations, the full parameter domain including sign/zero endpoints, normalization or pushforward evidence, and outcome-equivariance evidence (or an explicit semantic no-transform/no-relabeling finding). Separately write the source and Lean distribution parameterizations: the exact scale/rate/precision/standard-deviation/variance convention, the parameter mapping formula, and a checked law equality or outcome-preservation bridge. A positive reparameterization or matching declaration name is not a law-equivalence argument. When a standard Measure/Kernel carrier transport is present, identify the source carrier and the Lean carrier, show whether every stage is one joint draw or a source-defined conditional kernel composition, and classify the measure as a source pushforward, source conditioning/restriction, source-defined joint kernel law, generated product/kernel measure, or weighted/tilted measure. A weighted likelihood measure is not a source pushforward without an explicit transport theorem. A rate-free or rate-indexed source claim needs a checked rate-indexed family bridge, not one selected Lean rate.

State exactly whether source and Lean use a pointwise conditional law, an almost-everywhere conditional version, positive-fiber identities, or measurable-event calibration. Expand the event, sigma-algebra/measurability, and joint-law formula; a statement about exact fibers does not silently determine atomless or null fibers. Any switch among these semantics needs a Lean-checked bridge, not a source-looking conditional-probability or calibration name.

expanded_shape_basis: transparent terminal definition closure with integration or expectation construct
dimensions.required_check: For every source or Lean expectation/integral reached through this model, identify the law and integrand and establish the exact definedness convention: measurability or a.e.-measurability, integrability/finite integral, or an explicitly extended-value integral. A displayed E[...] is not a total Real number merely because a predictor or classifier was named; indicator and strategy correctness functions require their own measurability/integrability bridge.

For every conditioning/partition formula reached through this model, compare finite, countable, and arbitrary partition scope; cell measurability, disjointness, and cover on the relevant support; and the value assigned when a cell has zero mass. Expand every ratio/branch used to totalize zero denominators. A finite measurable-cell proof or a positive-mass-only identity does not cover an advertised arbitrary partition without a Lean-checked refinement.

Compare the source rate codomain with the Lean codomain after unfolding the rate definition. A Real-valued formula is not automatically a WithTop/extended-real statement: account for eventual-zero events, infinite rates, zero sample counts, and boundary minimizers.

  (SourceDefinition2ConditionalAt F D theta hatom ↔ 0 < d2Numerator / d2Denominator) ∧
  ((0 < d2Numerator / d2Denominator) ↔ d2Shared < d2Independent)

dimensions.required_check: Compare every expanded Lean binder domain, result quantifier, and proposition against the literal source statement. Check direction, scope, endpoint, and fixed-versus-uniform quantification; alpha-renaming is not a semantic change. For every formula used as a transformed density, likelihood, kernel, or probability law, check its sign, normalization, and Jacobian factor across the entire declared parameter domain. An algebraic scaling formula is not a probability-law conclusion outside the domain where those facts are proved.

dimensions.required_check: Compare the Lean carrier, finiteness/order/subtype restrictions, and every generic Type/Sort quantifier with the source domain. An arbitrary carrier or a silently strengthened finite carrier needs a source anchor or a checked bridge. When an expanded finite carrier encodes a source cardinal parameter through index arithmetic such as Fin (n + c), state the source parameter, the Lean expression, and a proved translation; local type names and inferred cardinality are not evidence. When a strict conclusion needs distinct, non-endpoint, or interior carrier elements, derive the exact cardinality threshold and witness from the source; a bare source phrase such as 'n candidates' does not supply N >= 3. When the generated surface requests a cardinality-boundary analysis, record the source and Lean cardinal domains, every smallest/endpoint case checked, and either the strictness witness or a semantic reason no such witness is needed. A theorem, wrapper, or carrier name is not that analysis. A local opaque/constant/axiom carrier must expose a checked refinement before it is treated as ordinary model data.

dimensions.required_check: For a finite/ordered probabilistic model, derive support at each endpoint from the source condition actually stated. Strict adjacent-tail comparisons do not by themselves supply a terminal cutoff or positive top/bottom atom; inspect zero mass, degenerate, and boundary cases separately.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded probability-law type surface
transparent terminal definition closure with probability or integration construct
dimensions.required_check: Identify the source stochastic process and the Lean joint law separately. Do not replace a source state recurrence, conditioning rule, or time-indexed law with an iid/product construction without a Lean-checked equality, simulation, or refinement from the source primitives. If either side sorts, ranks, relabels, or quotients samples before computing an outcome, prove the corresponding pushforward and outcome-equivariance bridge; matching marginal tables or an informal exchangeability argument is not enough. When the generated surface requests transformed-law analysis, record the source and Lean operations, the full parameter domain including sign/zero endpoints, normalization or pushforward evidence, and outcome-equivariance evidence (or an explicit semantic no-transform/no-relabeling finding). Separately write the source and Lean distribution parameterizations: the exact scale/rate/precision/standard-deviation/variance convention, the parameter mapping formula, and a checked law equality or outcome-preservation bridge. A positive reparameterization or matching declaration name is not a law-equivalence argument. When a standard Measure/Kernel carrier transport is present, identify the source carrier and the Lean carrier, show whether every stage is one joint draw or a source-defined conditional kernel composition, and classify the measure as a source pushforward, source conditioning/restriction, source-defined joint kernel law, generated product/kernel measure, or weighted/tilted measure. A weighted likelihood measure is not a source pushforward without an explicit transport theorem. A rate-free or rate-indexed source claim needs a checked rate-indexed family bridge, not one selected Lean rate.

State exactly whether source and Lean use a pointwise conditional law, an almost-everywhere conditional version, positive-fiber identities, or measurable-event calibration. Expand the event, sigma-algebra/measurability, and joint-law formula; a statement about exact fibers does not silently determine atomless or null fibers. Any switch among these semantics needs a Lean-checked bridge, not a source-looking conditional-probability or calibration name.

expanded_shape_basis: transparent terminal definition closure with integration or expectation construct
dimensions.required_check: For every source or Lean expectation/integral reached through this model, identify the law and integrand and establish the exact definedness convention: measurability or a.e.-measurability, integrability/finite integral, or an explicitly extended-value integral. A displayed E[...] is not a total Real number merely because a predictor or classifier was named; indicator and strategy correctness functions require their own measurability/integrability bridge.

For every conditioning/partition formula reached through this model, compare finite, countable, and arbitrary partition scope; cell measurability, disjointness, and cover on the relevant support; and the value assigned when a cell has zero mass. Expand every ratio/branch used to totalize zero denominators. A finite measurable-cell proof or a positive-mass-only identity does not cover an advertised arbitrary partition without a Lean-checked refinement.

Compare the source rate codomain with the Lean codomain after unfolding the rate definition. A Real-valued formula is not automatically a WithTop/extended-real statement: account for eventual-zero events, infinite rates, zero sample counts, and boundary minimizers.

When an expanded finite carrier encodes a source cardinal parameter through index arithmetic such as Fin (n + c), state the source parameter, the Lean expression, and a proved translation; local type names and inferred cardinality are not evidence. When a strict conclusion needs distinct, non-endpoint, or interior carrier elements, derive the exact cardinality threshold and witness from the source; a bare source phrase such as 'n candidates' does not supply N >= 3. When the generated surface requests a cardinality-boundary analysis, record the source and Lean cardinal domains, every smallest/endpoint case checked, and either the strictness witness or a semantic reason no such witness is needed. A theorem, wrapper, or carrier name is not that analysis. A local opaque/constant/axiom carrier must expose a checked refinement before it is treated as ordinary model data.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded probability-law type with finite or ordered carrier
transparent terminal definition closure with finite or ordered probability construct
dimensions.required_check: For a finite/ordered probabilistic model, derive support at each endpoint from the source condition actually stated. Strict adjacent-tail comparisons do not by themselves supply a terminal cutoff or positive top/bottom atom; inspect zero mass, degenerate, and boundary cases separately.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded probability-law type surface
transparent terminal definition closure with probability or integration construct
transparent terminal definition closure with standard Measure/Kernel carrier transport
unexpanded or bounded terminal definition path requiring a semantic bridge
dimensions.required_check: Identify the source stochastic process and the Lean joint law separately. Do not replace a source state recurrence, conditioning rule, or time-indexed law with an iid/product construction without a Lean-checked equality, simulation, or refinement from the source primitives. If either side sorts, ranks, relabels, or quotients samples before computing an outcome, prove the corresponding pushforward and outcome-equivariance bridge; matching marginal tables or an informal exchangeability argument is not enough. When the generated surface requests transformed-law analysis, record the source and Lean operations, the full parameter domain including sign/zero endpoints, normalization or pushforward evidence, and outcome-equivariance evidence (or an explicit semantic no-transform/no-relabeling finding). Separately write the source and Lean distribution parameterizations: the exact scale/rate/precision/standard-deviation/variance convention, the parameter mapping formula, and a checked law equality or outcome-preservation bridge. A positive reparameterization or matching declaration name is not a law-equivalence argument. When a standard Measure/Kernel carrier transport is present, identify the source carrier and the Lean carrier, show whether every stage is one joint draw or a source-defined conditional kernel composition, and classify the measure as a source pushforward, source conditioning/restriction, source-defined joint kernel law, generated product/kernel measure, or weighted/tilted measure. A weighted likelihood measure is not a source pushforward without an explicit transport theorem. A rate-free or rate-indexed source claim needs a checked rate-indexed family bridge, not one selected Lean rate.

expanded_shape_basis: unexpanded or bounded terminal definition path requiring a semantic bridge
dimensions.required_check: State exactly whether source and Lean use a pointwise conditional law, an almost-everywhere conditional version, positive-fiber identities, or measurable-event calibration. Expand the event, sigma-algebra/measurability, and joint-law formula; a statement about exact fibers does not silently determine atomless or null fibers. Any switch among these semantics needs a Lean-checked bridge, not a source-looking conditional-probability or calibration name.

expanded_shape_basis: transparent terminal definition closure with integration or expectation construct
unexpanded or bounded terminal definition path requiring a semantic bridge
dimensions.required_check: For every source or Lean expectation/integral reached through this model, identify the law and integrand and establish the exact definedness convention: measurability or a.e.-measurability, integrability/finite integral, or an explicitly extended-value integral. A displayed E[...] is not a total Real number merely because a predictor or classifier was named; indicator and strategy correctness functions require their own measurability/integrability bridge.

expanded_shape_basis: unexpanded or bounded terminal definition path requiring a semantic bridge
dimensions.required_check: For every conditioning/partition formula reached through this model, compare finite, countable, and arbitrary partition scope; cell measurability, disjointness, and cover on the relevant support; and the value assigned when a cell has zero mass. Expand every ratio/branch used to totalize zero denominators. A finite measurable-cell proof or a positive-mass-only identity does not cover an advertised arbitrary partition without a Lean-checked refinement.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded extended-rate codomain surface
transparent terminal definition closure with extended-rate construct
dimensions.required_check: Compare the source rate codomain with the Lean codomain after unfolding the rate definition. A Real-valued formula is not automatically a WithTop/extended-real statement: account for eventual-zero events, infinite rates, zero sample counts, and boundary minimizers.

theorem theorem3_source_complete_semantic_complete_literal_payoff
    {n : ℕ} (D : Measure (ValueProfile n)) [IsProbabilityMeasure D]
    (center : Ranking n) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hvalue : ∀ c : Candidate n,
      Integrable (fun value : ValueProfile n => value c) D)
    (hstrict : ∀ᵐ value ∂D, StrictlyOrderedBy center value) :
    theorem3_source_complete_semantic_completeSpec D center hn hvalue hstrict := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro phi theta hphi htheta
    refine ⟨(source_equation8_concrete_mallows_probability center phi theta
      hphi htheta center).1, ?_⟩
    intro value pi
    simpa [fixedCenterMallowsDistributionalFamily] using
      (source_equation8_concrete_mallows_probability center phi theta
        hphi htheta pi).2
  · intro value horder
    have hdefinition : SourceDefinition1NoisyPermutationFamily
        (fixedCenterMallowsPointFamily center value) center := by
      simpa only [fixedCenterMallowsPointFamily] using
        (concreteMallowsAccuracyFamily_sourceDefinition1 center value horder)
    simpa only [SourceDefinition1NoisyPermutationFamily] using hdefinition
  · intro theta htheta
    let F := fixedCenterMallowsDistributionalFamily center
    let hatom : ∀ ranking : Ranking n,
        Measurable fun value => F.dist theta value ranking :=
      fun ranking => DistributionalAccuracyFamily.fixedCenterMallows_ranking_atom_measurable
        center theta ranking
    have hevent : 0 < ∫ x : ValueProfile n × RankingPair n,
        (if firstChoice x.2.1 ≠ firstChoice x.2.2 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂
          F.outerIndependentPairJointLaw D theta hatom := by
      simpa [F, hatom, disagreementEvent] using
        DistributionalAccuracyFamily.fixedCenterMallows_outerJointDisagreementEvent_pos
          D center theta
    have hgain : 0 < F.jointLawDisagreementConditionalGain D theta hatom := by
      simpa [F, hatom] using
        DistributionalAccuracyFamily.fixedCenterMallows_outer_jointLawDisagreementConditionalGain_pos
          D center hn theta htheta hvalue hstrict
    refine ⟨hevent, ?_⟩
    have hdisagreement_event : 0 < ∫ x : ValueProfile n × RankingPair n,
        (if disagreementEvent x.2 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂
          F.outerIndependentPairJointLaw D theta hatom := by
      simpa only [disagreementEvent] using hevent
    have hnum_eq :
        (∫ x : ValueProfile n × RankingPair n,
          if disagreementEvent x.2 then pairRerankingGain x.1 x.2 else 0 ∂
            F.outerIndependentPairJointLaw D theta hatom) =
        ∫ x : ValueProfile n × RankingPair n,
          if firstChoice x.2.1 ≠ firstChoice x.2.2 then
            x.1 (firstChoice x.2.1) - x.1 (secondChoice x.2.1)
          else 0 ∂F.outerIndependentPairJointLaw D theta hatom := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with x
      by_cases h : firstChoice x.2.1 = firstChoice x.2.2
      · have h0 : x.2.1 0 = x.2.2 0 := by simpa [firstChoice] using h
        simp [disagreementEvent, firstChoice, secondChoice, h0]
      · have h0 : x.2.1 0 ≠ x.2.2 0 := by simpa [firstChoice] using h
        have hne : firstChoice x.2.1 ≠ firstChoice x.2.2 := h
        simp only [disagreementEvent, if_pos hne]
        change EconCSLib.SocialChoice.Ranking.rerankingGainOnPair
          x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2 = x.1 (x.2.1 0) - x.1 (x.2.1 1)
        exact EconCSLib.SocialChoice.Ranking.rerankingGainOnPair_of_neFirst
          x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2 h0
    have hden_eq :
        (∫ x : ValueProfile n × RankingPair n,
          if disagreementEvent x.2 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 ∂
            F.outerIndependentPairJointLaw D theta hatom) =
        ∫ x : ValueProfile n × RankingPair n,
          if firstChoice x.2.1 ≠ firstChoice x.2.2 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 ∂
            F.outerIndependentPairJointLaw D theta hatom := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with x
      rfl
    have hratio : F.jointLawDisagreementConditionalGain D theta hatom =
        (∫ x : ValueProfile n × RankingPair n,
          if firstChoice x.2.1 ≠ firstChoice x.2.2 then
            x.1 (firstChoice x.2.1) - x.1 (secondChoice x.2.1)
          else 0 ∂F.outerIndependentPairJointLaw D theta hatom) /
        (∫ x : ValueProfile n × RankingPair n,
          if firstChoice x.2.1 ≠ firstChoice x.2.2 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 ∂
            F.outerIndependentPairJointLaw D theta hatom) := by
      unfold DistributionalAccuracyFamily.jointLawDisagreementConditionalGain
      dsimp only
      rw [if_neg (ne_of_gt hdisagreement_event), hnum_eq, hden_eq]
    rw [← hratio]
    exact hgain
  · intro thetaA thetaH hthetaH hthetaA
    have h := fixedCenterMallows_outer_prefersWeakerCompetition
      D center hn thetaA thetaH hthetaH hthetaA hvalue hstrict
    simpa [DistributionalAccuracyFamily.PrefersWeakerCompetition,
      DistributionalAccuracyFamily.outerExpected,
      expectedSecondMoverIndependent] using h
  · intro thetaH hthetaH
    have hterminal := fixedCenterMallows_outer_distributionalTheorem1Target
      D center hn thetaH hthetaH hvalue hstrict
    simpa only [literal_outer_payoff_paradox,
      DistributionalAccuracyFamily.theorem1_f,
      DistributionalAccuracyFamily.theorem1_g,
      DistributionalAccuracyFamily.theorem1_h,
      DistributionalAccuracyFamily.theorem1_algorithmAgainstHuman,
      DistributionalAccuracyFamily.outerExpected] using hterminal

dimensions.required_check: Compare every expanded Lean binder domain, result quantifier, and proposition against the literal source statement. Check direction, scope, endpoint, and fixed-versus-uniform quantification; alpha-renaming is not a semantic change. For every formula used as a transformed density, likelihood, kernel, or probability law, check its sign, normalization, and Jacobian factor across the entire declared parameter domain. An algebraic scaling formula is not a probability-law conclusion outside the domain where those facts are proved.

expanded finite carrier requiring boundary-case review
finite carrier with nontrivial index arithmetic
dimensions.required_check: Compare the Lean carrier, finiteness/order/subtype restrictions, and every generic Type/Sort quantifier with the source domain. An arbitrary carrier or a silently strengthened finite carrier needs a source anchor or a checked bridge. When an expanded finite carrier encodes a source cardinal parameter through index arithmetic such as Fin (n + c), state the source parameter, the Lean expression, and a proved translation; local type names and inferred cardinality are not evidence. When a strict conclusion needs distinct, non-endpoint, or interior carrier elements, derive the exact cardinality threshold and witness from the source; a bare source phrase such as 'n candidates' does not supply N >= 3. When the generated surface requests a cardinality-boundary analysis, record the source and Lean cardinal domains, every smallest/endpoint case checked, and either the strictness witness or a semantic reason no such witness is needed. A theorem, wrapper, or carrier name is not that analysis. A local opaque/constant/axiom carrier must expose a checked refinement before it is treated as ordinary model data.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded probability-law type with finite or ordered carrier
transparent terminal definition closure with finite or ordered probability construct
dimensions.required_check: For a finite/ordered probabilistic model, derive support at each endpoint from the source condition actually stated. Strict adjacent-tail comparisons do not by themselves supply a terminal cutoff or positive top/bottom atom; inspect zero mass, degenerate, and boundary cases separately.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded probability-law type surface
transparent terminal definition closure with probability or integration construct
dimensions.required_check: Identify the source stochastic process and the Lean joint law separately. Do not replace a source state recurrence, conditioning rule, or time-indexed law with an iid/product construction without a Lean-checked equality, simulation, or refinement from the source primitives. If either side sorts, ranks, relabels, or quotients samples before computing an outcome, prove the corresponding pushforward and outcome-equivariance bridge; matching marginal tables or an informal exchangeability argument is not enough. When the generated surface requests transformed-law analysis, record the source and Lean operations, the full parameter domain including sign/zero endpoints, normalization or pushforward evidence, and outcome-equivariance evidence (or an explicit semantic no-transform/no-relabeling finding). Separately write the source and Lean distribution parameterizations: the exact scale/rate/precision/standard-deviation/variance convention, the parameter mapping formula, and a checked law equality or outcome-preservation bridge. A positive reparameterization or matching declaration name is not a law-equivalence argument. When a standard Measure/Kernel carrier transport is present, identify the source carrier and the Lean carrier, show whether every stage is one joint draw or a source-defined conditional kernel composition, and classify the measure as a source pushforward, source conditioning/restriction, source-defined joint kernel law, generated product/kernel measure, or weighted/tilted measure. A weighted likelihood measure is not a source pushforward without an explicit transport theorem. A rate-free or rate-indexed source claim needs a checked rate-indexed family bridge, not one selected Lean rate.

State exactly whether source and Lean use a pointwise conditional law, an almost-everywhere conditional version, positive-fiber identities, or measurable-event calibration. Expand the event, sigma-algebra/measurability, and joint-law formula; a statement about exact fibers does not silently determine atomless or null fibers. Any switch among these semantics needs a Lean-checked bridge, not a source-looking conditional-probability or calibration name.

For every source or Lean expectation/integral reached through this model, identify the law and integrand and establish the exact definedness convention: measurability or a.e.-measurability, integrability/finite integral, or an explicitly extended-value integral. A displayed E[...] is not a total Real number merely because a predictor or classifier was named; indicator and strategy correctness functions require their own measurability/integrability bridge.

For every conditioning/partition formula reached through this model, compare finite, countable, and arbitrary partition scope; cell measurability, disjointness, and cover on the relevant support; and the value assigned when a cell has zero mass. Expand every ratio/branch used to totalize zero denominators. A finite measurable-cell proof or a positive-mass-only identity does not cover an advertised arbitrary partition without a Lean-checked refinement.

dimensions.required_check: Compare the Lean carrier, finiteness/order/subtype restrictions, and every generic Type/Sort quantifier with the source domain. An arbitrary carrier or a silently strengthened finite carrier needs a source anchor or a checked bridge. When an expanded finite carrier encodes a source cardinal parameter through index arithmetic such as Fin (n + c), state the source parameter, the Lean expression, and a proved translation; local type names and inferred cardinality are not evidence. When a strict conclusion needs distinct, non-endpoint, or interior carrier elements, derive the exact cardinality threshold and witness from the source; a bare source phrase such as 'n candidates' does not supply N >= 3. When the generated surface requests a cardinality-boundary analysis, record the source and Lean cardinal domains, every smallest/endpoint case checked, and either the strictness witness or a semantic reason no such witness is needed. A theorem, wrapper, or carrier name is not that analysis. A local opaque/constant/axiom carrier must expose a checked refinement before it is treated as ordinary model data.

dimensions.required_check: Identify the source stochastic process and the Lean joint law separately. Do not replace a source state recurrence, conditioning rule, or time-indexed law with an iid/product construction without a Lean-checked equality, simulation, or refinement from the source primitives. If either side sorts, ranks, relabels, or quotients samples before computing an outcome, prove the corresponding pushforward and outcome-equivariance bridge; matching marginal tables or an informal exchangeability argument is not enough. When the generated surface requests transformed-law analysis, record the source and Lean operations, the full parameter domain including sign/zero endpoints, normalization or pushforward evidence, and outcome-equivariance evidence (or an explicit semantic no-transform/no-relabeling finding). Separately write the source and Lean distribution parameterizations: the exact scale/rate/precision/standard-deviation/variance convention, the parameter mapping formula, and a checked law equality or outcome-preservation bridge. A positive reparameterization or matching declaration name is not a law-equivalence argument. When a standard Measure/Kernel carrier transport is present, identify the source carrier and the Lean carrier, show whether every stage is one joint draw or a source-defined conditional kernel composition, and classify the measure as a source pushforward, source conditioning/restriction, source-defined joint kernel law, generated product/kernel measure, or weighted/tilted measure. A weighted likelihood measure is not a source pushforward without an explicit transport theorem. A rate-free or rate-indexed source claim needs a checked rate-indexed family bridge, not one selected Lean rate.

dimensions.required_check: State exactly whether source and Lean use a pointwise conditional law, an almost-everywhere conditional version, positive-fiber identities, or measurable-event calibration. Any switch among these semantics needs a Lean-checked bridge, not a source-looking conditional-probability or calibration name.

theorem lemma7_source_phi_complete
    {n : ℕ} (center : Ranking n) (phi theta : ℝ)
    (hphi : 1 < phi) (htheta : theta = phi - 1)
    {value : Candidate n → ℝ} (hvalue : StrictlyOrderedBy center value) :
    let M := concreteMallowsSpec center theta
    M.q = phi⁻¹ ∧
      (∀ pi : Ranking n,
        (M.law pi).toReal =
          phi⁻¹ ^ kendallTau center pi /
            (∑ tau : Ranking n, phi⁻¹ ^ kendallTau center tau)) ∧
      expectedSecondMoverIndependent M.law M.law value <
        expectedFirstMoverUtility M.law value := by
  dsimp
  have hq := source_equation8_concrete_mallows_probability center phi theta
    hphi htheta center
  refine ⟨hq.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro pi
    exact (source_equation8_concrete_mallows_probability center phi theta
      hphi htheta pi).2
  · have hq_lt_one : (concreteMallowsSpec center theta).q < 1 := by
      rw [hq.1]
      exact inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hphi
    have hvalue' :
        StrictlyOrderedBy (concreteMallowsSpec center theta).center value := by
      intro a b hab
      exact hvalue (by
        simpa [concreteMallowsSpec, MallowsSpec.ofQ] using hab)
    exact KR21Monoculture.MallowsComparison.paper_lemma7_mallows_first_mover_gt_second_human
      (M := concreteMallowsSpec center theta) hvalue' hq_lt_one

dimensions.required_check: Compare every expanded Lean binder domain, result quantifier, and proposition against the literal source statement. Check direction, scope, endpoint, and fixed-versus-uniform quantification; alpha-renaming is not a semantic change. For every formula used as a transformed density, likelihood, kernel, or probability law, check its sign, normalization, and Jacobian factor across the entire declared parameter domain. An algebraic scaling formula is not a probability-law conclusion outside the domain where those facts are proved.

expanded_shape_basis: generic, finite, subtype, or opaque carrier surface
expanded finite carrier requiring boundary-case review
finite carrier with nontrivial index arithmetic
dimensions.required_check: Compare the Lean carrier, finiteness/order/subtype restrictions, and every generic Type/Sort quantifier with the source domain. An arbitrary carrier or a silently strengthened finite carrier needs a source anchor or a checked bridge. When an expanded finite carrier encodes a source cardinal parameter through index arithmetic such as Fin (n + c), state the source parameter, the Lean expression, and a proved translation; local type names and inferred cardinality are not evidence. When a strict conclusion needs distinct, non-endpoint, or interior carrier elements, derive the exact cardinality threshold and witness from the source; a bare source phrase such as 'n candidates' does not supply N >= 3. When the generated surface requests a cardinality-boundary analysis, record the source and Lean cardinal domains, every smallest/endpoint case checked, and either the strictness witness or a semantic reason no such witness is needed. A theorem, wrapper, or carrier name is not that analysis. A local opaque/constant/axiom carrier must expose a checked refinement before it is treated as ordinary model data.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded probability-law type with finite or ordered carrier
transparent terminal definition closure with finite or ordered probability construct
dimensions.required_check: For a finite/ordered probabilistic model, derive support at each endpoint from the source condition actually stated. Strict adjacent-tail comparisons do not by themselves supply a terminal cutoff or positive top/bottom atom; inspect zero mass, degenerate, and boundary cases separately.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded probability-law type surface
transparent terminal definition closure with probability or integration construct
unexpanded or bounded terminal definition path requiring a semantic bridge
dimensions.required_check: Identify the source stochastic process and the Lean joint law separately. Do not replace a source state recurrence, conditioning rule, or time-indexed law with an iid/product construction without a Lean-checked equality, simulation, or refinement from the source primitives. If either side sorts, ranks, relabels, or quotients samples before computing an outcome, prove the corresponding pushforward and outcome-equivariance bridge; matching marginal tables or an informal exchangeability argument is not enough. When the generated surface requests transformed-law analysis, record the source and Lean operations, the full parameter domain including sign/zero endpoints, normalization or pushforward evidence, and outcome-equivariance evidence (or an explicit semantic no-transform/no-relabeling finding). Separately write the source and Lean distribution parameterizations: the exact scale/rate/precision/standard-deviation/variance convention, the parameter mapping formula, and a checked law equality or outcome-preservation bridge. A positive reparameterization or matching declaration name is not a law-equivalence argument. When a standard Measure/Kernel carrier transport is present, identify the source carrier and the Lean carrier, show whether every stage is one joint draw or a source-defined conditional kernel composition, and classify the measure as a source pushforward, source conditioning/restriction, source-defined joint kernel law, generated product/kernel measure, or weighted/tilted measure. A weighted likelihood measure is not a source pushforward without an explicit transport theorem. A rate-free or rate-indexed source claim needs a checked rate-indexed family bridge, not one selected Lean rate.

expanded_shape_basis: unexpanded or bounded terminal definition path requiring a semantic bridge
dimensions.required_check: State exactly whether source and Lean use a pointwise conditional law, an almost-everywhere conditional version, positive-fiber identities, or measurable-event calibration. Expand the event, sigma-algebra/measurability, and joint-law formula; a statement about exact fibers does not silently determine atomless or null fibers. Any switch among these semantics needs a Lean-checked bridge, not a source-looking conditional-probability or calibration name.

expanded_shape_basis: unexpanded or bounded terminal definition path requiring a semantic bridge
dimensions.required_check: For every source or Lean expectation/integral reached through this model, identify the law and integrand and establish the exact definedness convention: measurability or a.e.-measurability, integrability/finite integral, or an explicitly extended-value integral. A displayed E[...] is not a total Real number merely because a predictor or classifier was named; indicator and strategy correctness functions require their own measurability/integrability bridge.

expanded_shape_basis: unexpanded or bounded terminal definition path requiring a semantic bridge
dimensions.required_check: For every conditioning/partition formula reached through this model, compare finite, countable, and arbitrary partition scope; cell measurability, disjointness, and cover on the relevant support; and the value assigned when a cell has zero mass. Expand every ratio/branch used to totalize zero denominators. A finite measurable-cell proof or a positive-mass-only identity does not cover an advertised arbitrary partition without a Lean-checked refinement.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded extended-rate codomain surface
transparent terminal definition closure with extended-rate construct
dimensions.required_check: Compare the source rate codomain with the Lean codomain after unfolding the rate definition. A Real-valued formula is not automatically a WithTop/extended-real statement: account for eventual-zero events, infinite rates, zero sample counts, and boundary minimizers.

model_conventions.checked_scope: PaperInterface.source_two_firm_selection_game_semantics makes the one-half payoff identity literal for every strategy profile. Equations (4) and (5) use exactly that identity; no claim is made that the archival prose explicitly specified a uniform distribution.
model_conventions.formal_meaning: The two labelled firms are each first with probability one half, independently of candidate values, ranking draws, and strategy randomization. Thus a labelled firm's ex-ante payoff is the arithmetic mean of its first-mover payoff and the payoff obtained when the other firm moves first.
model_conventions.why_needed: The source says only that the two firms hire 'in a random order.' Equations (4) and (5), and the Lean game semantics, use an unweighted sum or division by two, which is valid only for a uniform arrival order. Treating that weight as implied by the word random would smuggle a material model choice into the source result.
